mapper.update: MERGE INTO ${format}_key_value USING (SELECT 1 FROM DUAL) ON (repository_id = #{repositoryId} AND category = #{category} AND `key` = #{key}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (repository_id, category, `key`, `value`, created) VALUES (#{repositoryId}, #{category}, #{key}, #{value}, now()) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET `value` = #{value}, created = now();

update.foreach: MERGE INTO ${format}_key_value USING (SELECT 1 FROM DUAL) ON (repository_id = #{item.repositoryId} AND category = #{item.category} AND `key` = #{item.key}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (repository_id, category, `key`, `value`, created) VALUES (#{item.repositoryId}, #{item.category}, #{item.key}, #{item.value}, now()) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET `value` = #{item.value}, created = now()
